title: Picking a piece by its colour

sections.title: The colour goes before the noun
sections.content: To pick one piece, put the description in front of the noun: *piros alma* (a red apple), *a sárga banán* (the yellow banana). The adjective never changes. When the fruit is the object, only the noun takes *-t*: *a piros almát*. The verb still follows the article you know: *a / az* + noun takes *kérem* or *veszem*, *egy* + noun takes *kérek* or *veszek*.

items.english: I won't take the green tomato.

sections.content: Put the *-t* on the noun only: *a piros almát*, never *a pirost almát*. Before a vowel use *az*, and *érett* starts with one: *az érett körtét*.
